Adds opt-in BIP84/BIP86 account recovery, independent receive/change discovery including spent-out history, adjustable scan limits and incomplete-scan handling.

Adds optional TLS backup servers, checkpoint checks and bounded waits. Preserves transaction history during encryption, protects data on failed migration, and clears deleted-wallet caches.

Updates startup, loading and receive QR branding. USDC totals now use two decimal places, with NeoxEX price refresh on opening or returning to the app. XBT precision is unchanged.

SegWit/Taproot, Unified signing, cold-signing flows, RBF/CPFP and earlier transaction/batch fixes are retained capabilities. Physical cold-device interoperability remains unverified pending completion of the separate cold wallet.
